description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) used for testing the pseudo-merge bitmap functionality in a Git project. It contains multiple test cases, setup functions, and configurations to verify the correctness of pseudo-merge bitmap implementation, including overlapping groups, thresholds, reuse, and boundary traversal.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges
methods.description: Runs the bitmap dump-pseudo-merges tool to list current pseudo-merge groups.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merge_commits
methods.description: Dumps the commits involved in a particular pseudo-merge group.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_satisfied
methods.description: Checks if the pseudo-merges satisfy their thresholds and configurations.

methods.name: test_pseudo_merges_cascades
methods.description: Verifies cascade relationships between pseudo-merge groups.

methods.name: tag_everything
methods.description: Creates tags for all commits in the repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with subsequent commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success PERL_TEST_HELPERS
methods.description: A special test case involving Perl helpers to test sample rate adjustments using bitmap pseudo merge parameters.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'bitmapPseudoMerge.threshold excludes newer commits'
methods.description: Tests that commits newer than a certain threshold are excluded from pseudo-merge consideration.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'bitmapPseudoMerge.stableThreshold creates stable groups'
methods.description: Tests the creation of stable pseudo-merge groups based on the stable threshold.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'out of order thresholds are rejected'
methods.description: Verifies that invalid threshold configurations are rejected with proper error messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'pseudo-merge pattern with capture groups'
methods.description: Tests the pattern matching capabilities with capture groups in pseudo-merge configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'pseudo-merge overlap setup'
methods.description: Prepares overlapping groups of pseudo-merges for subsequent overlap tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'pseudo-merge overlap generates overlapping groups'
methods.description: Verifies that overlapping pseudo-merge groups are correctly identified.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'pseudo-merge overlap traversal'
methods.description: Tests traversal over overlapping pseudo-merge groups.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'pseudo-merge reuse'
methods.description: Tests object reuse across pseudo-merges when appropriate.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'empty pseudo-merge group'
methods.description: Checks behavior when creating a pseudo-merge group with no unstable commits.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'pseudo-merge closure'
methods.description: Tests the handling of pseudo-merge closure and dependencies.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'use pseudo-merge in boundary traversal'
methods.description: Verifies that pseudo-merge can be used during boundary traversal in pack processing.
